context: Checks the Bun workflow for dependency changes: runtime confirmation, lockfile conflict resolution, test validation and documented decisions.

checklist.name: States lockfile strategy
checklist.description: States whether `bun.lock` or `bun.lockb` is the lockfile in use before installing

checklist.name: Uses bun install
checklist.description: Installs with `bun install`, including to add the dependency

checklist.name: Rejects npm install
checklist.description: Does not run `npm install` and explains that the README instruction is stale for a Bun-managed repo

checklist.name: Resolves conflict markers
checklist.description: Opens the lockfile, resolves the conflict markers and only then re-runs `bun install`

checklist.name: Tests after dependency change
checklist.description: Runs `bun test` straight after the dependency change

checklist.name: Reverts on failure
checklist.description: If a test fails, reverts the last change and confirms the error before fixing

checklist.name: Re-validates after fix
checklist.description: Re-runs the tests after addressing the specific failure

checklist.name: Runs anti-pattern checks
checklist.description: Applies the anti-pattern checks before declaring the work finished

checklist.name: Links references in notes
checklist.description: The decision note links the exact reference files used
